report_name: Ransomware Attacks Plague Municipalities and Global Businesses

threat_actors.name: RansomHouse
threat_actors.description: A data extortion group that claimed responsibility for attacks on the U.S. cities of Beacon, NY, and McMinnville, OR. The group operates a data extortion market, threatening to leak stolen data.

threat_actors.name: Qilin
threat_actors.description: A prolific ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS) gang linked to new breaches at a Turkish law firm and other international businesses, employing double-extortion tactics.

threat_actors.name: LGroup
threat_actors.description: A lesser-known extortion group that claimed responsibility for an attack on a U.S. food distribution company.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: Core technique used by the ransomware groups to encrypt victim files and demand a ransom.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over Web Service
attack_patterns.description: Sensitive data was exfiltrated by the ransomware groups to cloud storage services using tools like rclone for double extortion purposes.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: Ransomware operators likely delete Volume Shadow Copies using vssadmin to prevent easy system recovery from local backups.

malware.name: Qilin Ransomware
malware.description: The ransomware payload used by the Qilin RaaS operation to encrypt victim systems as part of their double-extortion attacks.

tools.name: vssadmin
tools.description: Used by ransomware operators to delete Volume Shadow Copies to inhibit system recovery.

tools.name: rclone
tools.description: A legitimate data transfer tool likely used by ransomware groups to exfiltrate large volumes of data to cloud storage for extortion.

tools.name: megacmd
tools.description: A legitimate data transfer tool likely used by ransomware groups to exfiltrate large volumes of data to cloud storage for extortion.

identities.name: City of Beacon, NY
identities.description: A U.S. municipality in New York targeted by the RansomHouse extortion group.

identities.name: City of McMinnville, OR
identities.description: A U.S. municipality in Oregon targeted by the RansomHouse extortion group.

identities.name: Akugur Law Firm
identities.description: A Turkish law firm targeted by the Qilin ransomware gang.

identities.name: Bloom Financials
identities.description: A UK-based financial business targeted by the Qilin ransomware gang.

identities.name: AmSpec Group
identities.description: A global business targeted by the Qilin ransomware gang.

identities.name: ALIZE SUD
identities.description: A French business targeted by the Qilin ransomware gang.

identities.name: Rupp Spritzguss
identities.description: A German manufacturing business targeted by the Qilin ransomware gang.

identities.name: Coast Produce
identities.description: A U.S. food distribution company targeted by the LGroup extortion group.

indicators.name: Exfiltration Tool File Artifacts
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Exfiltration Tool File Artifact
id: 7c5a8d3e-1b9f-4e2a-9c6d-0a1b3e5d7f9a
status: experimental
description: Detects the presence of common data exfiltration tools like rclone.exe or megacmd.exe.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-07
references:
  - https://www.breachsense.com/breaches/
tags:
  - attack.t1567
  - attack.exfiltration
level: medium
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\rclone.exe'
      - '\megacmd.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects file artifacts related to common data exfiltration tools rclone and megacmd.

indicators.name: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
id: f8a1b2c3-d4e5-4f6a-8b9c-0d1e2f3a4b5c
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common precursor to ransomware deployment.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-07
references:
  - https://www.breachsense.com/breaches/
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of vssadmin to delete volume shadow copies, a common ransomware TTP to inhibit system recovery.

indicators.name: Exfiltration Tool Execution
indicators.pattern:
title: Exfiltration Tool Execution
id: a9b8c7d6-e5f4-4a3b-9c8d-7e6f5a4b3c2d
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of common data exfiltration tools like rclone.exe or megacmd.exe.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-07
references:
  - https://www.breachsense.com/breaches/
tags:
  - attack.t1567
  - attack.exfiltration
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\rclone.exe'
      - '\megacmd.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of legitimate data transfer tools like rclone and megacmd, which are often abused by attackers for data exfiltration.

indicators.name: Ransomware Note File Creation
indicators.pattern:
title: Ransomware Note Or Encrypted File Creation
id: b1c2d3e4-f5a6-4b7c-8d9e-0f1a2b3c4d5e
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of files with extensions or names commonly used by ransomware for encrypted files or ransom notes.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-07
references:
  - https://www.breachsense.com/breaches/
tags:
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.locked'
      - '.agenda'
      - '.READ_ME'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of files with common ransomware extensions or ransom note names.
